description: pyatlan Renovate config: extends the Atlan fleet preset that application-sdk and the atlan-*-app repos use. Repo-local overrides below cover where pyatlan differs. It runs on the Mend-hosted app, not the self-hosted fleet runner (that runner only discovers atlan-*-app repos). It publishes a library with a py3.9 floor, and main has no required status checks yet.

lockFileMaintenance.description: Two overrides of the preset's lock lane. (1) Clear postUpgradeTasks.commands: the preset's release-age bound runs as `renovate-uv-lock-bounded`, which exists only on the self-hosted fleet runner. Mend cannot run it and would publish a permanent red renovate/artifacts status, the same reason application-sdk clears it. (2) Do not auto-merge. Without that command the lock refresh has no release-age bound on transitive packages, so a human reviews it until a bound exists here (uv exclude-newer or a lock-cooldown workflow). Weekly, so the review cost stays at one PR a week.

packageRules.description: No required status checks protect main yet: the only ruleset is the Copilot-review one. platformAutomerge hands the merge to GitHub native auto-merge, which waits only for REQUIRED checks, so it would merge a red PR. With platformAutomerge off, Renovate merges itself, and it does so only when every check on the branch is green. Flip this back to true once main has a ruleset that requires the pyatlan-pr checks. Matches every update, so it overrides each preset lane that sets platformAutomerge: true.

CI interpreter pins are not routine bumps. The github-actions manager reads each actions/setup-python `python-version` input as dep `python`, and a lookup dry-run proposed 3.9 / 3.11 / 3.12 -> 3.15. Those pins are deliberate here: 3.9 is the oldest interpreter pyatlan supports, so the publish and compatibility jobs must stay on it. The preset's github-actions group would otherwise auto-merge them alongside action bumps. application-sdk caps the same dep at <3.15. pyatlan disables it outright, because moving any of these pins is a support-matrix decision. The test matrices use `${{ matrix.python-version }}` and are not matched at all.

Review github-actions majors instead of auto-merging them. pyatlan-pr.yaml's change filter skips the unit and integration jobs when a PR touches only .github/, so a green check on an action-bump PR does not show the bumped action was exercised. Minor, patch and digest bumps keep the preset's auto-merge.

Hold third-party action releases for the fleet's 3-day release-age window, the same window the preset applies to third-party PyPI packages. The preset applies it only to the pypi datasource, so without this rule a freshly pushed (or re-pointed) action tag could be auto-merged within the hour. Positive matchUpdateTypes, so updates without a timestamp (digest) are not silently suppressed.

Leave the py3.9 / py3.10 compatibility pins alone (BLDX-1571). pyproject.toml splits several dependencies with a `python_version < '3.10'` (networkx: `< '3.11'`) marker that holds the last release still supporting the older interpreter. Renovate's pep621 manager ignores markers, so it proposes moving those lines to the same release as their >=3.10 twins (measured with a lookup dry-run: pydantic ~=2.13.4 -> ~=2.14.2, pytest ~=8.4.2 -> ~=9.2.0, ...). The uv lock then has no py3.9 candidate, and because the preset groups every PyPI minor/patch into one 'non-critical python dependencies' PR, a single such line fails the whole group. Each entry matches one held line by its exact current value, so the >=3.10 twin keeps updating. In-range fixes for the held lines still arrive through lock maintenance. When a held pin is moved by hand, update its entry here. When py3.9 support is dropped, delete this rule along with the markers.
